description: The omission predicate tests T<$S> against value "" and the singleton tag set T. It permits the omission of T. Both parse configurations choose T with elision-only off and on (engine §3.8, §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%const $S T
%rule text (A [+T<$S>]) | (A [+OTHER] [+OTHER]) | (A [+OTHER] [+OTHER] [+OTHER]) %conditions ($ ≅ #« A T="" » ∨ $ ≅ #« A OTHER OTHER [OTHER] »)
